spans.text: All references to the character must use functional designations
spans.note: The system prompt instructs the AI to act as an 'expert interactive narrative designer' and generate mod frameworks for character-based roleplay scenarios. The generated mods are designed to create immersive narrative experiences where an AI assumes a character role, and the prompt explicitly instructs never using the character's names but using 'functional designations' — this framework facilitates AI systems impersonating characters without clear disclosure of AI nature to end users. The mod structure (prologue, stages, dramatic arcs) is designed to create an illusion of interacting with a character rather than an AI.
